card.name: Antidepressant warning wording and regulation numbers
card.fires_on: The ending 'ant' in 'antidepressant' within the suicidality warning sentence 'whether or not they are taking antidepressant medications'. It also fires on a few isolated spots such as a digit in a regulation number or 'any' in an ectopic pregnancy warning.

modes.label: Antidepressant ending
modes.description: The final piece of 'antidepressant' just before 'medications' in the suicidality warning.
modes.example: whether or not they are taking antidepress<<ant>> medications, and this risk may persist until

modes.label: Regulation number digit
modes.description: A digit inside a Code of Federal Regulations citation.

modes.label: 'any' in pregnancy warning
modes.description: The word 'any' before 'female who becomes pregnant' in an ectopic pregnancy warning.
modes.example: Evaluate for possible ectopic pregnancy in<< any>> female who becomes pregnant while using Parag

card.plain: It lights up at the end of the word antidepressant in the standard suicidality warning, and rarely elsewhere in label text.
